inputAndAlignment.source: use each control's exact replay HUD pixels and frozen SS0 candidate geometry; 270x270 owner fixtures feed unchanged owner-replay extraction geometry, never descriptor-specific preprocessing
inputAndAlignment.referenceWarp: existing frozen production candidate warp geometry only aligns source/reference samples; descriptor signals are evaluated directly
inputAndAlignment.support: normalized source annulus 0.20<=r<=0.78 with fixed 3-pixel canonical border excluded
inputAndAlignment.interpolation: existing replay/production bilinear sampling semantics, identical for GT and wrong candidates

candidatePolicy.correct: exact SS0 :gt-local row; GT identity only from independent ground truth
candidatePolicy.wrongSet: all SS0 WRONG rows on the control which Pareto-dominate GT in (scaleAwareStructure,intensityNcc), plus SS0 final WRONG candidate; deduplicate candidateId
candidatePolicy.strongestWrong: maximum new-descriptor score within frozen wrongSet
candidatePolicy.rank: 1+count(frozen wrong scores strictly greater than GT); ties separately reported
candidatePolicy.missingOwnerGeometry: where SS0 table omits x/y/radius, reconstruct with unchanged production replay inputs and D0 only; D1-D4 may not be inspected until D0 geometry/score reproduction passes

D0.name: CURRENT_PRIMITIVE_BASELINE
D0.purpose: diagnostic control only; no new weighting or thresholds

D1.name: LOCAL_CENSUS_ORDINAL
D1.samples: all integer offsets (dy,dx), dy=-3..3 outer loop then dx=-3..3, excluding (0,0), exactly 48 bits
D1.validity: center and all samples inside common support
D1.score: equal source/reference bits / 48, averaged uniformly over valid centers

D2.name: UNSIGNED_GRADIENT_ORIENTATION
D2.magnitude: sqrt(gx^2+gy^2), divide by support p90 then clip 0..1, epsilon=1e-6
D2.score: weighted mean over common support, null if weight sum<=1e-6

D3.name: SYMMETRIC_EDGE_DISTANCE_CHAMFER
D3.edgeRule: magnitude>=support p85, percentile independently per aligned patch with identical rule
D3.distance: Euclidean distance transform to nearest edge
D3.directed: mean(min(distance,6)/6) from each edge set to other
D3.insufficient: score=null and descriptor coverage failure; no threshold retune

D4.name: SKELETON_NETWORK_DISTANCE
D4.skeleton: deterministic Zhang-Suen thinning; row-major simultaneous deletion each sub-iteration; max 128 full iterations or convergence
D4.distance: same symmetric Euclidean distance-transform formula as D3
D4.insufficient: score=null and descriptor coverage failure; no threshold retune

D5.reason: disabled before outcomes; may not be added later

poseGrid.symmetry: identical grid around GT and every frozen wrong base candidate

phase3SymmetricPose.selection: best descriptor score within identical 243-pose grid independently around each frozen GT/wrong candidate
phase3SymmetricPose.comparison: best GT versus best strongest wrong

classes.DR-STABLE: correct preferred both and absolute margin change<=0.10
classes.DR-PARTIAL: correct preferred both and absolute margin change>0.10

retrievalProxy.conditional: only descriptors satisfying owner/Fang/drift local survivor predicates; never rescues local failure
retrievalProxy.population: all 424 exact Dashen z5 tile centers from artifact 9210943659; sort (tileY,tileX), center=(tileX*256+128,tileY*256+128), same population every control
retrievalProxy.pose: same exact 243-pose grid at every sampled center
retrievalProxy.gtNeighborhood: sampled center nearest independent GT; descriptor cannot redefine
retrievalProxy.rank: 1+count(non-GT sampled centers score>GT-center score); ties separately counted
retrievalProxy.wrongAboveGT: count non-GT sampled centers score>GT-center score
retrievalProxy.falseBasinConcentration: 8-connected components in z5 tile-index space among centers above GT; largestCount/max(1,wrongAboveGT), component count, largest members
retrievalProxy.runtime: warm-up first 10 candidate-pose evaluations then wall-clock descriptor only; median and p95 ms/candidate-pose

stress40Frame.conditional: only if owner>=4/6, both regions, Fang and drift survive and retrieval shows no newly stronger persistent false basin
stress40Frame.perFrame: top center, top score, runner-up, epsilon-0.01 uniqueness, runtime
stress40Frame.topCandidateRecurrence: histogram exact top centers; max recurrence/40
stress40Frame.topBasinPersistence: 8-connected components of top centers over time; largest recurrence/40, neutral because absolute GT unavailable
stress40Frame.candidateDiversity: distinct top centers/40 and normalized natural-log Shannon entropy
stress40Frame.descriptorStability: median and worst consecutive-frame z5-pixel distance plus median top-runner margin
stress40Frame.prohibited: no localization PASS/FAIL or absolute correctness; no temporal voting/tuning

survivorRule.regionRequirement: at least one positive owner margin in Qinghe and one in Kaifeng
survivorRule.fang: GT preferred over all frozen SS0 dominators candidate-locked and symmetric-pose
survivorRule.persistentFalseBasin: no newly stronger persistent sampled wrong basin

finalCases.RD0: D1-D4 non-separable similarly to primitives; learned known-GT representation justified; no reweighting
finalCases.RD1: one common frozen descriptor satisfies survivor rule; separate production-candidate architecture task justified, no production modification now
finalCases.RD2: partial representation rescue; heterogeneous failure split, no universal fix claim
finalCases.RD3: new representation unsafe due stronger/more stable false basins; reject family
